description: MCPAgent's own instructions, added to the shared ones (context/instructions.json).
name: the agent's name, put into the shared identity lines; it answers with it when asked.
instructions: lines added after the shared instructions, for what is particular to this agent.
Its display name for the tools (AGENT_NAME) is tools_env in mcpagent/jsons/mcpagent.json, since
its MCP server is what runs them.
MCPAgent runs tool calls one at a time: its MCP server is single-flight (a second call while one
runs is refused), so the agent asks the model for one call per response, and says so here.
name: mcp
